value.description: The controlled keys of the selected items

default-value.description:
The initial default value of the listbox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the listbox.

selection-mode.description:
How multiple selection should behave in the listbox.

- `single`: The user can select a single item.
- `multiple`: The user can select multiple items without using modifier keys.
- `extended`: The user can select multiple items by using modifier keys.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

highlightchange.description: Fired when the highlighted item changes.

valuechange.description: Fired when the selected item changes.

scrollToIndexFn.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

collection.description: The items to choose from, e.g. from `createListCollection`. Assign a new collection to update the list.

Function to clear the value of the select.
If a value is provided, it will only clear that value, otherwise, it will clear all values.
